metrics.profile_summary: Performance Marketer with 2+ years of experience managing high-budget paid media across Meta, Google, and TikTok. Expert in ROAS optimization, UTM tracking, and marketing automation for e-commerce and B2B sectors.

experience.description: Manages $20k+ monthly ad spend across Google, DSP, and TikTok; implemented n8n and Google Sheets automation for reporting.
Led full-funnel strategies for 8+ brands, achieving 6+ ROAS through creative iteration and landing page optimization.
Executed Meta campaigns and managed content calendars, increasing Instagram and LinkedIn engagement by 140%.
Managed lead generation campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and Google Ads, improving CTR by 25%.

strengths: Advanced proficiency in Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads
Expertise in UTM tracking and performance reporting
Proficient in all 'nice-to-have' tools (Canva, Meta Business Suite, Excel/Sheets)
Strong background in content calendar management and creative coordination
weaknesses: Bachelor's degree is still in progress (expected 2027)
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an overqualified technical match for the Marketing Specialist role. He possesses all required platform skills and exceeds expectations in reporting and automation, though he has not yet completed his degree.
